newsitem.title: FINLAND: VIKING JAN-JUNE PASSENGERS UP SLIGHTLY.
newsitem.headline: VIKING JAN-JUNE PASSENGERS UP SLIGHTLY.

text.p: Finnish passenger ferry operator Viking Line said in a statement on Wednesday its January-June passenger volume rose to 2.30 million from 2.28 million in the year-ago period.
"Viking Line's total passenger outcome for the period was strengthened somewhat overall, to 2,299,000 from 2,282,000, due to the positive trend in Sweden-Aland-Finland traffic," the company said.

The passenger volume between Finland and Estonia fell 69,000 to 627,904 due to laid-down day cruises to Estonia as a result of changed import regulations, and because Viking does not run catamaran traffic between Helsinki and Tallinn due to a lack of suitable capacity, it said.
The passenger volume in traffic between Sweden, Aland and Finland rose by 85,000 or 5.4 percent to 1.67 million, linked to an increase in capacity in April, Viking Line said.
